{"title":"Proactive support system for four friends","content":"## Overview
Create a sustainable, proactive support system that combines (1) consistent emotional check-ins, (2) plans that actually happen, and (3) specific practical help offers—tailored to each friend’s current stressors.

## Strategy
- **Consistency beats intensity:** small recurring touchpoints + 1–2 anchored plans/week.
- **Specific offers > vague offers:** propose concrete times + options (ride, meal, packing help, interview prep).
- **Lightweight tracking:** one place to track last check-in, next action, and upcoming dates.

## Output of this plan
- A shared set of support “rules” (your time budget, response norms, escalation).
- One tailored mini-plan per friend (next 2–3 weeks + ongoing cadence).
- A combined weekly schedule and message templates you can reuse.
